prompt: A compound with M⁺ = 59 shows strong fragments at 44 (M−15) and 29. These fragments suggest the compound is MOST likely:

options.label: An aldehyde or amine (M = 59 fits propionamide HCONHCH3 or similar; losses of 15 (CH3) and 29 (CHO) are classic)

explanation: M = 59 with loss of 15 (CH₃) and 29 (CHO or C₂H₅) is characteristic of small amides/aldehydes. Nitrogen rule: odd M = odd number of N atoms, so a 1-N species like N-methylacetamide (CH₃CONHCH₃, M = 73 — no), or a smaller N compound fits.
